Smriti Mandhana Breaks Records in Women's Cricket

Indian cricketer Smriti Mandhana has achieved significant milestones in women's cricket, setting multiple records. She surpassed Mithali Raj in career runs, becoming the highest run-scorer in women's cricket history. Mandhana also broke world records previously held by Mithali Raj and Meg Lanning. In a recent Asia Cup 2026 semi-final match, India secured a dominant victory by 137 runs, with Mandhana's batting performance described as exceptional. Indian captain Harmanpreet Kaur expressed gratitude for having Mandhana play for the country. Mandhana dedicated her Player of the Match award, stating there was no specific person she was dedicating it to.
